HabomDemo.title: Mini demo
HabomDemo.lead: The prologue and two scenes from the game demo, as they appear in the game. Music plays, and some lines are voiced.
HabomDemo.keyHint: Click the screen, or focus it and press Enter or Space to continue. The game shortcuts also work (Esc menu, A auto, Ctrl skip, L backlog, H hide UI).
HabomDemo.nameHelp: Leave it blank to use "Player". Up to 10 characters.
HabomDemo.chapterJihyeDesc: Jihye comes back home and cooks fried rice for you.
HabomDemo.chapterSaeunDesc: Can't sleep, so you head to the living room and run into Saeun.
HabomDemo.endTitle: This is the end of the demo
HabomDemo.endBody: The story continues in the full game.
